$comment: Driver (Mulank) and Conductor (Bhagyank) together: one reading for each of the 81 pairs, read as driver-conductor. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.driver_conductor.tone.friendly: The driver and conductor support each other: the way of acting and the direction of life pull the same way, so effort tends to bring results.
blocks.driver_conductor.tone.neutral: The driver and conductor neither help nor hinder each other. Results depend on conscious choices more than on natural flow.
blocks.driver_conductor.tone.opposed: The driver and conductor pull in different directions. Progress comes, but it asks for patience and for bridging two ways of being.
blocks.driver_conductor.special.4-8: The 4 and 8 pair is treated with care in popular Indian practice: both carry Saturn's weight. Expect delays and hard lessons that build great resilience; steady discipline and avoiding risky shortcuts turn this pair into lasting achievement.
blocks.driver_conductor.special.8-8: A double 8 doubles Saturn's influence: heavy responsibility, slow progress and, in time, solid authority. Patience, fairness and rest are the keys.
blocks.driver_conductor.special.4-4: A double 4 doubles Rahu's restlessness and originality. Life brings sudden turns; a calm routine and careful planning keep the energy productive.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-1: A double Sun: strong will, confidence and leadership. Success comes through independence; the challenge is to let others share the stage.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-2: Sun with Moon: a leader with a caring path. Ambition is softened by sensitivity, and partnerships help the drive find its direction.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-3: Sun with Jupiter: confidence guided by wisdom. A strong pairing for authority, teaching and respected leadership.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-4: Sun with Rahu: initiative meets an unconventional path. Plans may change suddenly; flexibility turns surprises into openings.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-5: Sun with Mercury: leadership with quick intelligence. Good for business and communication, if decisions are not rushed.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-6: Sun with Venus: pride and comfort can pull apart. Balancing ambition with relationships and home life is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-7: Sun with Ketu: outward drive with an inward-looking path. Leadership finds its best form in research, insight or spiritual guidance.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-8: Sun with Saturn: quick ambition on a slow road. Results come later than hoped, but they last when patience is kept.
blocks.driver_conductor.1-9: Sun with Mars: energy and courage in abundance. A powerful pair for leadership and action, provided temper is managed.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-1: Moon with Sun: a sensitive nature on a path of leadership. Confidence grows with each step forward, and kindness makes the leadership trusted.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-2: A double Moon: deep feeling, intuition and care. Life goes well in partnership; emotional steadiness is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-3: Moon with Jupiter: gentleness guided by wisdom. Good for teaching, counselling and family leadership.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-4: Moon with Rahu: a sensitive nature on a changeable path. Routine and trusted people give stability when life turns suddenly.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-5: Moon with Mercury: feeling meets quick thought. Creative and communicative, though moods and restlessness need balancing.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-6: Moon with Venus: warmth, art and love of home. A soft, creative pairing that thrives in caring and artistic work.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-7: Moon with Ketu: intuition runs very deep. Spiritual and imaginative gifts are strong; staying grounded is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-8: Moon with Saturn: sensitivity on a demanding path. Responsibility comes early; self-care and support keep the spirit light.
blocks.driver_conductor.2-9: Moon with Mars: care meets courage. Protective and passionate, with a need to calm quick emotions.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-1: Jupiter with Sun: wisdom on a path of authority. A respected pairing for leadership, law, teaching and public life.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-2: Jupiter with Moon: guidance with warmth. Good for counselling, teaching and leading families or communities.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-3: A double Jupiter: learning, principle and growth. Respect comes through knowledge; humility keeps it.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-4: Jupiter with Rahu: tradition meets the unconventional. Wisdom grows by questioning old ideas; patience with change helps.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-5: Jupiter with Mercury: knowledge and communication can clash in style. Depth and speed must be balanced for best results.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-6: Jupiter with Venus: principle and pleasure pull apart. Success comes when values and comforts are kept in balance.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-7: Jupiter with Ketu: wisdom on a spiritual path. Strong for philosophy, research and guiding others inward.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-8: Jupiter with Saturn: wisdom on a disciplined path. Slow, solid growth; respect builds over decades.
blocks.driver_conductor.3-9: Jupiter with Mars: wisdom joined with courage. A strong pairing for leadership, protection and principled action.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-1: Rahu with Sun: an independent thinker on a path of leadership. Original ideas can lead others, if conflict with authority is handled wisely.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-2: Rahu with Moon: practical restlessness on a caring path. Calm routines and steady relationships bring balance.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-3: Rahu with Jupiter: an unconventional mind on a path of wisdom. Questioning becomes insight when it is disciplined.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-4: A double 4: hard work, originality and sudden turns. See the special note on this pair.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-5: Rahu with Mercury: practical intelligence with quick wit. Good for technology, systems and trade.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-6: Rahu with Venus: practical work joined with a sense of beauty. Good for design, architecture and building comfortable homes.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-7: Rahu with Ketu: a mind that seeks beneath the surface. Research and innovation suit this pair; grounding routines help.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-8: Rahu with Saturn: discipline on a heavy path. See the special note on this pair.
blocks.driver_conductor.4-9: Rahu with Mars: unconventional energy. Bold action needs careful planning to avoid hasty mistakes.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-1: Mercury with Sun: quick wit on a path of leadership. Good for business ownership and public roles.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-2: Mercury with Moon: a quick mind on a sensitive path. Communication and creativity flourish when moods are steady.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-3: Mercury with Jupiter: cleverness on a path of wisdom. Depth must be chosen over speed for lasting success.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-4: Mercury with Rahu: adaptable intelligence on a practical path. Strong for technology, trade and systems.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-5: A double Mercury: very quick, versatile and sociable. Success comes through communication; focus is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-6: Mercury with Venus: wit and charm together. A friendly pairing for business, the arts and partnerships.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-7: Mercury with Ketu: a quick mind with a deep path. Strong for research, writing and analysis.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-8: Mercury with Saturn: quick thinking on a slow path. Patience turns cleverness into lasting results.
blocks.driver_conductor.5-9: Mercury with Mars: quick wit and quick action. Energetic and competitive; careful thought before acting helps.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-1: Venus with Sun: love of comfort on a path of leadership. Balancing relationships with ambition is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-2: Venus with Moon: charm on a sensitive path. Warm and artistic, though Venus and the Moon do not always agree; kindness to self helps.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-3: Venus with Jupiter: pleasure meets principle. Values and comforts must be kept in balance for peace of mind.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-4: Venus with Rahu: beauty on a practical path. Strong for design, property and creating lasting comfort.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-5: Venus with Mercury: charm and intelligence. A pleasant, successful pairing for business, art and relationships.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-6: A double Venus: love, beauty and responsibility. Home and family are central; avoiding excess is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-7: Venus with Ketu: love on a spiritual path. Art and devotion go well together.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-8: Venus with Saturn: grace on a disciplined path. Friendly planets: steady love and solid comfort grow over time.
blocks.driver_conductor.6-9: Venus with Mars: warmth meets passion. Creative and affectionate, with a need to balance desire and patience.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-1: Ketu with Sun: a reflective nature on a path of leadership. Leading through insight suits better than leading through force.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-2: Ketu with Moon: deep intuition on a caring path. Spiritual, imaginative and empathic.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-3: Ketu with Jupiter: insight on a path of wisdom. Strong for teaching, philosophy and guiding others.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-4: Ketu with Rahu: depth on an unconventional path. Research and innovation suit; grounding is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-5: Ketu with Mercury: depth meets quick thought. Analysis and writing are strengths.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-6: Ketu with Venus: reflection on a loving path. Art and spiritual devotion blend well.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-7: A double 7: very reflective, intuitive and independent. Time alone is essential; sharing insights is the work.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-8: Ketu with Saturn: depth on a disciplined path. Patient research and long study bring respect.
blocks.driver_conductor.7-9: Ketu with Mars: inner fire. Courage guided by insight; strong for healing, research and causes.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-1: Saturn with Sun: patience on a path of authority. Leadership comes later and lasts; avoid power struggles.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-2: Saturn with Moon: discipline on a sensitive path. Responsibility for others is strong; rest and warmth matter.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-3: Saturn with Jupiter: discipline on a path of wisdom. Slow, principled growth into respect.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-4: Saturn with Rahu: hard work on a changeable path. Careful planning protects against sudden setbacks.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-5: Saturn with Mercury: patience with quick wit. A practical pairing for business and finance.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-6: Saturn with Venus: steady effort brings comfort and beauty. A friendly, prosperous pairing over time.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-7: Saturn with Ketu: endurance on a deep path. Long study and research reward patience.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-8: A double Saturn. See the special note on this pair.
blocks.driver_conductor.8-9: Saturn with Mars: patience and haste in tension. Discipline must guide energy; avoid rash decisions.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-1: Mars with Sun: courage on a path of leadership. A strong, active pairing; temper must be governed.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-2: Mars with Moon: courage on a caring path. Protective and warm; calm reflection balances quick emotion.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-3: Mars with Jupiter: courage guided by wisdom. A strong pairing for principled leadership and service.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-4: Mars with Rahu: bold energy on an unconventional path. Plan before acting to avoid sudden reversals.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-5: Mars with Mercury: action meets quick thought. Energetic and capable; patience in speech helps.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-6: Mars with Venus: passion with warmth. Creative and loving; balance between desire and duty helps.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-7: Mars with Ketu: courage on a spiritual path. Strong for healing, service and causes.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-8: Mars with Saturn: energy on a slow road. Patience and discipline turn struggle into strength.
blocks.driver_conductor.9-9: A double Mars: great energy, courage and drive. Success through action; calm and forgiveness are the work.
